newsitem.title: USA: Argonaut says is strong despite Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: Argonaut says is strong despite Q3 loss.

text.p: Argonaut Group said Friday that it remains financially strong despite a third quarter loss of $5.82 per share that included charges for $229 million in increased loss reserves.

The company said its premium-to-capital ratio is 0.4 to 1, which it said is "significantly more favorable than comparable industry ratios," and said its book value was $644 million, or $27 per common share, at the end of the quarter.
"Given that, and with no long-term debt on the balance sheet, Argonaut Group remains very well capitalized and financially strong," Chief Executive Charles Rinsch said.
